content.short: gatekeep.xyz provides anti-theft protection for crypto wallets by intercepting malicious transactions before on-chain processing.
content.description: gatekeep.xyz provides 24/7 protection for crypto wallets in a landscape where theft remains a constant risk. With more than $2B stolen annually and no fully automated safeguards against theft, gatekeep.xyz aims to be part of onboarding conversations to help new Web3 users stay safe. It offers practical guidance and considerations for protecting wallets, keys, and transactions as newcomers begin to explore decentralized finance and digital assets, supporting safer first steps into crypto.
